title: Mystic Scroll of Realms
description: An ancient rectangular scroll lies diagonally across a cosmic background, covered in intricate line drawings of a long serpentine dragon. Swirling, translucent ribbons of green, orange, and purple energy flow across the scroll, surrounding two glowing orbs - one large iridescent sphere with rainbow highlights and one smaller multicolored orb.
prompt: Ancient rectangular scroll with detailed line art of a serpentine dragon, floating in a cosmic void. Swirling translucent ribbons of green, orange, and purple magical energy flow across the aged parchment. Two glowing orbs hover above the scroll - a large iridescent sphere showing rainbow colors and a smaller multicolored orb. Dramatic lighting, intricate details, mystical atmosphere, painterly digital art style.
